summary: Shopfront kerb with parked cars; no homes within 25 m on this side.

drivers.seclusion: Backed by commercial buildings 5-6 m away; only dwelling in range is Ikon apartments 27 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars sit along the kerb here; room for a van before the junction at the east end.
drivers.traffic: Busy shopping-strip road near a junction; noisy but only passing drivers see the van.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; 2P signs apply only Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm and Sat to 4pm, not overnight; No Stopping near the corner.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs near the east end
Noise from the junction and nearby hotel
sun_shade: Open to the sky; shopfronts to the south shade the kerb in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Station Road south kerb, outside the corner cafe and shops
